title: Chuck E. Cheese
specs: Trampoline Zone is purpose-built for young children with a 56-inch height limit to avoid collisions with older kids
Chuck E. Cheese has a proprietary Kid Check UV hand-stamp system for child safety
First family entertainment center brand to earn the Ecolab Science Certified Seal for cleaning
Kids must be under 56 inches tall to use the Trampoline Zone
All guests under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian for the entire visit

blurb: Chuck E. Cheese offers a safe, enclosed Trampoline Zone exclusively for kids under 56 inches tall, arcade games, freshly made pizza, and birthday party packages. The Trampoline Zone includes unlimited jump passes and grip socks with admission. Birthday parties include gameplay, drinks, a birthday show, and optional add-ons like pizza and party hosts.
extraNote: Birthday party deposit is $25; deposits are non-refundable but can be applied to a new reservation within 90 days · Adults attend birthday parties at no charge but must pay for food and drinks separately · No drop-offs allowed; Kid Check UV hand-stamp system matches children to adults · All You Can Jump pass allows unlimited trampoline jumping with same-day return with receipt
